name: Diff_TF_MA_EA
summary: This EA trades based on the difference between moving averages from two different timeframes. It compares the MA values from a higher and a lower timeframe to generate buy and sell signals when the differential crosses threshold levels. The strategy aims to capture trend alignment across multiple timeframes for higher-probability entries.
summary_zh: 该EA基于两个不同周期移动平均线的差值进行交易。它比较高周期和低周期的MA值，当差值穿越阈值水平时产生买入和卖出信号。该策略旨在通过多周期趋势对齐来提高入场概率。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是利用两个不同时间框架的移动平均线差值来判断市场趋势方向。入场条件为：当快周期MA与慢周期MA的差值超过设定的阈值时，产生买入或卖出信号，差值为正且增大时做多，差值为负且减小时做空。出场条件依赖于反向信号触发或止损止盈设置。仓位管理方面，EA允许用户固定手数交易，但没有看到动态仓位调整或基于资金比例的仓位管理机制。资金管理较为基础，主要依赖止损止盈参数控制单笔风险。整体策略逻辑简单明了，多周期对齐思路有助于过滤假信号，但缺乏对市场波动性和交易成本（点差）的考虑。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA utilizes the difference between moving averages from two different timeframes to determine market trend direction. Entry conditions are triggered when the differential between the fast-timeframe MA and slow-timeframe MA exceeds a user-defined threshold: a positive and increasing differential generates buy signals while a negative and decreasing differential generates sell signals. Exit conditions rely on reverse signal triggers or stop-loss and take-profit settings. Position sizing allows the user to specify a fixed lot size, but there is no dynamic position sizing or equity-proportional lot calculation mechanism. Money management is relatively basic, primarily relying on stop-loss and take-profit parameters to control per-trade risk. The overall strategy logic is straightforward, and the multi-timeframe alignment approach helps filter false signals, but it lacks consideration for market volatility and trading costs such as spread.

parameters.name: Diff_Threshold
parameters.description: 差值阈值，触发交易的最小差值
parameters.description_en: Difference threshold; minimum spread to trigger trade

pros: 多周期分析思路合理，能有效过滤单周期假信号
策略逻辑简洁清晰，参数直观易于理解和调优
使用MA差值而非简单交叉，提供了更精细的趋势强度判断
支持自定义两个时间框架和MA周期，灵活性较高
pros_en: Multi-timeframe analysis approach is sound, effectively filtering single-timeframe false signals
Strategy logic is concise and clear, parameters are intuitive and easy to understand and optimize
Using MA differential rather than simple crossover provides a finer measure of trend strength
Supports customizable timeframes and MA periods, offering good flexibility
cons: 固定手数交易缺乏动态仓位管理，无法根据账户资金自动调整风险敞口
未考虑点差和滑点对交易成本的影响，在短线操作中可能侵蚀利润
没有新K线检查机制，可能在同一根K线上重复开仓
缺乏对市场波动性（如ATR）的适应性，阈值在不同市场环境下可能失效
止损止盈为固定点数，未考虑不同货币对的波动特征差异
cons_en: Fixed lot sizing lacks dynamic position management, unable to automatically adjust risk exposure based on account equity
Does not account for spread and slippage impact on trading costs, which may erode profits in short-term operations
No new bar check mechanism, potentially opening repeated positions on the same bar
Lacks adaptability to market volatility (e.g., ATR), thresholds may become ineffective under different market conditions
Stop-loss and take-profit use fixed pip values, not considering volatility differences across currency pairs
improvements: 增加基于ATR的动态差值阈值和止损止盈，使策略能适应不同市场波动环境
添加新K线检查和持仓检查逻辑，防止重复开仓和过度交易
引入基于账户余额比例的动态仓位管理，实现更科学的资金管理
improvements_en: Add ATR-based dynamic differential threshold and stop-loss/take-profit to adapt to varying market volatility conditions
Implement new bar check and position check logic to prevent repeated entries and over-trading
Introduce equity-proportional dynamic position sizing for more scientifically grounded money management

risk_points: 缺乏新K线检查，可能在同一根K线反复开仓导致过度暴露
固定止损止盈不适应不同市场波动环境，可能频繁被止损或止盈过远
没有点差过滤，在点差较大的品种或时段交易成本不可控
risk_points_en: Lack of new bar check may cause repeated position opening on the same bar, leading to overexposure
Fixed stop-loss and take-profit do not adapt to different market volatility environments, potentially causing frequent stop-outs or overly distant targets
No spread filter means trading costs are uncontrolled on pairs or sessions with wide spreads
